title: node-fetch-server can try to send an error response after headers are committed
author: mjackson
body_preview: ### Summary  `@remix-run/node-fetch-server` catches errors from `sendResponse()` and attempts to send an error response. However, `sendResponse()` writes status and headers before streaming the response body. title: node-fetch-server request bodies can hang after client aborts
author: mjackson
body_preview: ### Summary  `@remix-run/node-fetch-server` creates a web `Request` body from a Node request stream, but the `ReadableStream` only listens for `data` and `end`. It does not propagate `error`, `aborted`, or early close from the incoming request into the web stream. title: doctor --fix can follow symlinks and write outside the app root
author: mjackson
body_preview: ### Summary  `remix doctor --fix` resolves proposed fix paths lexically under the app root, but the actual filesystem writes follow symlinks. title: Fragment-nested `<Frame>` doesn't adopt its hydration marker
author: markmals
body_preview: A `<Frame>` that is the first child of a bare `<Fragment>` (`<>`) returned by a `clientEntry` fails to adopt its server-rendered frame markers during hydration. It takes the fresh-insert path instead, duplicating the streamed subtree and re-fetching `src` on the client. Wrapping the same `<Frame>` in a host element (e.g. `<div>`) makes it hydrate cleanly. title: createAtmosphereAuthProvider handle resolution can take nearly 2 minutes because of Promise.allSettled
author: knotbin
body_preview: `createAtmosphereAuthProvider` starts DNS and HTTPS handle resolution in parallel, but appears to wait for both branches to settle before using a successful result.
